name: SOP & Process Engineering
description: Turn an informal recurring operation into a measurable, exception-aware process and usable SOP with controls, ownership, and change management.

tasks.name: Map current process
tasks.objective: Document actual triggers, inputs, steps, tools, roles, decisions, queues, handoffs, exceptions, rework, controls, outputs, evidence, timings, and pain points through observation and practitioner input.

tasks.name: Analyze failure and waste
tasks.objective: Identify bottlenecks, duplicate entry, unclear ownership, unnecessary approvals, error-prone transitions, control gaps, accessibility issues, and high-cost exceptions. Quantify where possible.

tasks.name: Design target process
tasks.objective: Simplify sequence, assign ownership, define decision rules, controls, service levels, escalation paths, exception handling, data requirements, automation candidates, and measurable outcomes.

tasks.name: Write operational SOP
tasks.objective: Create stepwise instructions with prerequisites, roles, screenshots or examples where useful, decision tables, exception paths, quality checks, records to retain, safety/compliance notes, and escalation contacts.

tasks.name: Pilot with real operators
tasks.objective: Run representative cases including exceptions with intended users. Measure completion, errors, ambiguity, handoff failures, time, and training burden; revise based on observed use.

tasks.name: Release and govern
tasks.objective: Publish versioned SOP, ownership, training, effective date, metrics, audit/review cadence, change request path, and retirement rules for obsolete versions.
